description:
Jeong Ha-neul spent her free-spirited 20s. However, 32-year-old Haneul is living an ordinary life after graduation, focusing on work and life.

Gradually losing the pleasure of a relationship with a younger boyfriend

As she is growing up, Haneul receives an offer from Sangwoo, a man who smells like her long-lost lover, or even more like her scent, to move into the share house he runs.

Haneul impulsively decides to move into a share house to relive the emotions of the glamorous past. The four share mates I met there evoke a strange nostalgia for Haneul...
